name: v0.6.14
body:
## What's Changed
* Use Python3.13 to build wheel by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/713
* apt update before installing libboost-dev / use local method for CUDA install by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/712
* Fix notfound mpi.h by @aiueo-1234 in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/708
* Update install commands on `CONTRIBUTING.md` by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/715
* Fix an incorrect swap insertion location bug related to FusedSWAP insertion by @Akihiro-Tabuchi in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/707
* ci(wheels): build and publish manylinux aarch64 wheels by @seba2390 in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/709
* Fix `PauliGate` and `PauliRotationGate` for MPI distributed state vectors by @nils-wittemeier in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/711
* Update action version by @serowri in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/717

## New Contributors
* @seba2390 made their first contribution in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/709
* @nils-wittemeier made their first contribution in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/711
* @serowri made their first contribution in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/717

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/compare/v0.6.13...v0.6.14

name: v0.6.13
body:
## What's Changed
* Windows Python3.13 support by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/686
* check SIMD by native architecture by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/688
* Fix: fail cuda compilation in HPC SDK by @aiueo-1234 in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/689
* Remove sequential push_backs to prevent excessive memory allocation by @m-ymzk in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/691
* Free on exception by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/693
* update sphinx and sphinx-autodoc version by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/701
* update runner image of macos by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/700
* Avoid OpenMP nested parallel by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/699

## New Contributors
* @aiueo-1234 made their first contribution in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/689

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/compare/v0.6.12...v0.6.13

name: v0.6.12
body:

* Update boost url, deprecate Python 3.8, support 3.13 by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/674
* specify conf.py explicitly by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/673
* Multi qubit measurement cptp by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/672
* Copying gate pointer for binding reference-returning method by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/675
* use ubuntu24.04 CI image by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/684
* remove Qulacs-Osaka merge information from README.md by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/683
* update pyproject.toml for PEP639 by @KowerKoint in https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/pull/679


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/qulacs/qulacs/compare/v0.6.11...v0.6.12
